subject: Top-band geo mitigation request: temporary supplement & COLA floor proposal
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Top-band geo mitigation request: temporary supplement & COLA floor proposal

Hi Monica / Marcus,

Quick note on offers for the Platform PM / Senior SWE roles we need to close in APAC and EU this quarter. Two immediate issues: supply for senior talent in SG/JP is tight and localized offer expectations (top of band) are exceeding our current bands by ~8-15% in market comps. If we don’t move quickly we’ll lose the strongest candidates.

Proposal (short):
- Approve a temporary "top-band supplement" (one-time adjustment applied to offers at top-of-band) of +10% for APAC senior hires in SG/HK/JP for hires signed by 2027-06-30.
- For EU hires, allow a +6% supplement where local market index shows a >6% deviation versus US baseline.
- Add a COLA-linked offer floor: offers cannot go below the local COLA-adjusted band floor calculated in the attached spreadsheet ("proposed_supplement_table.xlsx").

Reasons:
- Market comp data (see attached) shows base salary pressure in SG/JP for cloud infra / platform skillsets.
- Supplements avoid permanent band inflation if we mark them clearly as time-bound and tracked against hires.
- COLA floor prevents under-allocating budget for cost-of-living-sensitive relocation packages and prevents repeated private exceptions.

Impact to budget: estimated incremental OTE spend for Q2 hiring wave = ~$175k (one-time) across 6 hires. Full breakdown in the attachment.

Ask: approval in principle so Talent Ops can proceed to candidate communication and we can route for final Finance/legal sign-off. For urgency: Haruka Sato (candidate) is on a two-week hold with FlexRecruit — we need to lock language this week if possible.

Attachments: proposed_supplement_table.xlsx, market_index_notes.pdf

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Lead, Technical Recruiting | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Top-band geo mitigation request: temporary supplement & COLA floor proposal

Thanks for the write-up, Priyom — good flag. I reviewed the attachment and ran a quick elasticity check against our current salary bands and the comp data from H2 2026. A few notes: 

- +10% for APAC senior hires is defensible for SG/JP in engineering-heavy roles, but I recommend limiting to roles with confirmed candidate scarcity (SWE Backend, Platform Infra, Senior PM). For UX/Design and IC2-level hires, suggest +7% cap.
- EU +6% seems OK but we must ensure currency-fluctuation protection (EUR vs USD) — recommend we tie the calculation to the 30-day rolling FX in the spreadsheet.
- Place a hard cap on absolute base salary (do not exceed X band top + 15% without exec approval).

Operational asks before I sign off:
1) Add a short clause to offers: "This temporary supplement is a one-time adjustment linked to current market conditions and is not a permanent change to Redwood’s compensation bands."
2) For every supplemented offer, require a short rationale (1-2 bullets) and approval chain: Recruiter -> Hiring Manager -> Marcus (Comp) -> Monica (Talent) -> Finance. This is HC-REQ-2027-112 in our tracker.

If we adopt those guardrails I can provisionally approve the numbers for the roles you flagged. I’ll also run a quick forecast of FY27 run-rate impact and post to the HC request later today.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal, Compensation Strategy | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Top-band geo mitigation request: temporary supplement & COLA floor proposal

Appreciate the clear proposal Priyom. I’m comfortable approving a time-bound supplement for the urgent hires so we don't lose Haruka and the SG candidates, provided Marcus's guardrails are added. Two additional asks:

- Legal should review the offer language for any implications on future employment letters and benefits; loop Legal 
- Finance needs to sign off on the incremental budget; please route the HC request with Marcus's FY27 impact note.

If we get Legal/Finance okay, I’ll rubber-stamp for Talent to proceed with candidate conversations. Also ask Talent to prepare a brief internal memo summarizing why each supplemented hire was necessary (to avoid audit questions later).

Monica
Monica Patel
VP, Talent | Redwood Inference

Priyom
